## Keep this link

This is your library. Bookmark it or paste it somewhere you will find it; it works on any device, and season-pass files refresh behind it every morning.

```{=html}
<input class="store-keep" data-store-keep type="text" readonly aria-label="Your library link" onclick="this.select()">
```

Treat it like a password: anyone with the link can download your files. Stripe has also emailed you a receipt; the receipt number on it gets your library back if you ever lose the link.
:::
::::

## Lost the page before it loaded?

Enter the email you paid with and the receipt number from your Stripe receipt.

```{=html}
<form class="store-recover" data-store-recover>
  <label>Email <input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required></label>
  <label>Receipt number <input type="text" name="receipt" placeholder="1234-5678" pattern="#?[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}" required></label>
  <button type="submit" class="btn store-add">Find my library</button>
  <span class="store-note" data-store-recover-status role="status"></span>
</form>
```

Questions about a file? The [data dictionary](index.qmd) for each dataset explains every column, and [help](help.qmd) covers formats, updates and the license. Anything else: [slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com](mailto:slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com).
